metadata.title: XPERT FACTOR | Enterprise Factoring Management Platform
metadata.description: End-to-end factoring software for banks and financial institutions, covering contracts, receivables, financing, collections, payments, reconciliation, accounting and reporting.

hero.title: Run the entire factoring lifecycle from one platform.
hero.description: XPERT FACTOR centralizes contracts, receivables, financing, collections, payments, reconciliation, risk and reporting in a unified platform for banks and financial institutions.
hero.trust: Built from decades of factoring expertise.

problem.title: Factoring breaks down when the workflow is fragmented.
problem.description: Disconnected contracts, receivables, risk decisions and payment records slow teams down and make control harder precisely when working capital matters most.
problem.solution: XPERT FACTOR brings the entire process into one controlled system.

factoringFlow.title: Finance the receivable. Preserve control of the cycle.
factoringFlow.description: The platform coordinates the commercial and financial relationships between seller, factor and buyer, then closes the loop through settlement and reconciliation.

lifecycle.title: One platform. The complete factoring lifecycle.
lifecycle.description: XPERT FACTOR is the operating layer for factoring teams, connecting every stage from onboarding to management reporting.

items.title: Client onboarding
items.detail: Create and organize the factoring relationship.

items.title: Receivable acquisition
items.detail: Register invoices, orders and eligible receivables.

items.title: Risk & limits
items.detail: Control buyer exposure, limits and insurance.

items.title: Financing
items.detail: Calculate and manage advances and commissions.

items.title: Collection
items.detail: Follow collections, maturity and unpaid invoices.

items.title: Payments
items.detail: Record incoming payments and settlement events.

items.title: Accounting
items.detail: Support the accounting operations of the activity.

items.title: Reporting
items.detail: Give operations and management a consolidated view.

modules.title: Everything factoring teams need, organized around the work.
modules.description: Explore the functional families that connect front office, back office, risk, accounting and management.

groups.label: Receivables
groups.title: Build a controlled receivables portfolio.
groups.description: Manage the commercial assets and contractual structures that sit at the heart of each factoring relationship.

groups.label: Financing
groups.title: Turn approved receivables into managed financing.
groups.description: Coordinate financing requests, calculations, advances, commissions and funding operations.

groups.label: Collections & payments
groups.title: Close the loop from collection to allocation.
groups.description: Track collections and incoming payments, then match each event to the right receivable and account.

groups.label: Risk & insurance
groups.title: Put exposure, limits and protection in view.
groups.description: Support insured and uninsured operations across domestic and international factoring models.

groups.label: Disputes
groups.title: Resolve exceptions without losing the audit trail.
groups.description: Keep operational exceptions attached to the receivable and visible to the teams responsible for resolution.

groups.label: Accounting & documents
groups.title: Connect operations to accounting and evidence.
groups.description: Bring accounting activities, reporting and supporting documents into the same operational context.

groups.label: Bank operations
groups.title: Fit the platform to a financial institution.
groups.description: Structure access, branches and analytical spaces around real banking responsibilities.

platform.title: Built for the people running factoring operations every day.
platform.description: Move between operational views without losing context. Each workspace connects decisions, transactions and follow-up.

views.label: Dashboard
views.title: Portfolio command center
views.description: A consolidated view of financing, collections, exceptions and operational priorities.

views.label: Contracts

views.description: Keep contractual terms, amendments, limits and guarantees organized around the client relationship.

views.label: Financing
views.title: Financing operations
views.description: Review eligible receivables, calculate financing and record operational decisions.

views.label: Payments
views.title: Payment and allocation control
views.description: Capture payments, allocate them and surface amounts that still require reconciliation.

views.label: Reporting
views.title: Operations and management reporting
views.description: Turn the operational record into activity views for back office, management and accounting teams.

bankOperations.title: Designed around real banking operations.
bankOperations.description: XPERT FACTOR connects the responsibilities of branches, operational teams, risk, accounting and management through one controlled platform.

ecosystem.title: One operational network around every factoring relationship.
ecosystem.description: The platform coordinates internal teams and the external participants involved in financing, protection, recovery and settlement.

visibility.title: Every operation. Visible. Controlled. Traceable.
visibility.description: Give each team the information it needs while keeping the full operational record connected.

items.label: Portfolio visibility
items.detail: Exposure and activity in one view

workflow.title: A continuous operational record from setup to reporting.
workflow.description: Each event advances the same controlled workflow, giving teams a clear view of what happened, what is next and where attention is required.

steps.title: Contract configured
steps.description: Terms, limits and guarantees establish the operating framework.

steps.title: Receivable acquired
steps.description: Invoices and eligible assets enter the managed portfolio.

steps.title: Financing approved
steps.description: Calculations, commissions and decisions are recorded.

steps.title: Payment received
steps.description: The incoming payment enters the operational queue.

steps.title: Matching completed
steps.description: Allocation and lettrage connect cash to the right receivable.

steps.title: Reporting updated
steps.description: Accounting and management views reflect the completed cycle.

flexibility.title: Standardized where it matters. Configurable where you need it.
flexibility.description: The standard XPERT FACTOR platform can be complemented with institution-specific modules, structures and workflows.

deployment.title: From project kickoff to an operational factoring platform.
deployment.description: A structured path aligns the standard platform with the institution's operating model, data and teams.
deployment.highlight: Standard version operational in approximately 120 days
deployment.disclaimer: The 120-day timeframe is the standard deployment target described by the product documentation; implementation scope can affect timing.

experience.title: Built on decades of factoring expertise.
experience.description: XPERT FACTOR has evolved since the early 2000s through operational experience, client feedback and continuous technology improvement.
